why: The control cards: predicted shape, decided shape, and whether they agreed — on point sets whose answer is known by construction. This is the positive control the rest of the geometry work is judged against.
rule: Mathematics, drawing code and records are crossed byte-for-byte. Every PAGE is rebuilt in this repository’s design system — no bench CSS, no bench HTML, no ECharts. Patches are declared here so they can never be mistaken for drift.
patches: page.js: kept for reference and superseded by build.js, which renders the same content in this repository's design system.

page.js and sets.js: prose references to "the reference playground" — this repository's own section, as the bench knew it — updated to "the reference instruments shelf" when the section moved from /playground to /instruments on 2026-09-04. Prose only; no number, no rule and no decision was touched. The same phrase survives untouched in decide.js and probe.js, which are comments and are never rendered.

decide.js: the exact-rational require repointed from the bench's lib/eqcert/rational.js to instruments/interval/rational.js, which is this repository's copy of the same library. Without it the folder crosses but does not run, and a record that cannot be regenerated is a record nobody can check.

sets.js: the four record paths repointed at THIS repository — playground/interferometer/out/page-data.json and vis.js, playground/plates/data/band-sigma-*.json, and certs/erdos1038-forcing-1.828.json, which is OUR forcing certificate (86 a-boxes, 1,350 b-boxes) rather than the bench's (332 and 40,000). The proof-walk set is therefore drawn from our own covering and its numbers differ from the bench's by design.
